title: Successive Walk Distribution
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$ on a finite vertex set, let $p$ assign a rational weight to each vertex, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The distribution obtained by walking for $k+1$ steps from $p$ equals the distribution obtained by first walking for one step and then for $k$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Regular multigraph of positive degree D
